# Agent DOG

> Paper-first DOG Army agent layer on top of Kraken CLI.

Agent DOG is a pack of 4 reusable agent skills for safe paper
trading of DOGUSD ($DOG Runes on Bitcoin layer-1). Built on Kraken
CLI. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI.

## Important Resources

- [README](README.md) — Project overview, install, usage
- [CONTEXT](CONTEXT.md) — Runtime context for agents
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md) — Full integration guide
- [CLAUDE](CLAUDE.md) — Claude-specific guidance
- [MCP Compatibility](docs/MCP_AGENT_COMPATIBILITY.md) — MCP setup
- [Safety Contract](docs/SAFETY.md) — Paper-only rules
